reviews.text: Knowledgeable, friendly.

We were able to get an appointment within a week due to, as it turned out, a neck hernia in our French Bulldog. Our regular vet thought it was his back. Three neck vertebrae were repositioned. Despite our dog being afraid of vets due to previous experiences, he remained surprisingly calm here. After the treatment, he even walked back to the vet. He was given medication with a clear explanation, and afterwards I had email contact three times with some additional questions. I received a reply to these the same day with a very committed and concrete answer. I am impressed by the professionalism and the excellent treatment.

We have been visiting Jacha Heukels with our dachshund for several years now. Simply for an annual preventative check-up. Every year, a few vertebrae are slightly misaligned, which she then skillfully and effortlessly puts back in order. We receive a prompt reminder every year, and making an appointment is easy. Even now, when we noticed a problem and emailed to ask if we could make an appointment, we were able to get in within two days. A lovely, friendly vet. Our Boef trots enthusiastically into her consulting room. Probably because he smells a huge jar of tasty treats, but surely also because he really wants to see Jacha. We are incredibly happy with Dr. Heukels. You wish every dog ​​owner an annual check-up.

Excellent orthomanual veterinarian.

Good accessibility and parking facilities.
Our French Bulldog was helped more than perfectly with his neck and back pain. There was time to help him the very same day!

Little dog Gijs and I are very happy with Jacha. …..Gijs is an adopted dog from Poland. He looks like a slightly larger dachshund with a curly tail 😉 (nature does funny things). From day 1, I noticed that he didn't really like being petted on his back. After a short checkup at the vet, we were back outside after 5 minutes with the message that everything was okay 😳!
Over time, Gijs didn't want to go for walks anymore; he would regularly stop until the moment he couldn't do anything anymore and screamed in pain. It was terrible to witness! It turned out to be a severe hernia, and the X-rays also showed an old hernia that could no longer be treated. He was scheduled for surgery the next day. Gijs needed a long period of rest after that, and then we had to slowly build everything back up. In the meantime, I had found Jacha and contacted him; I wanted a checkup once he had recovered. I am so glad we did that. There were several vertebrae she treated.
That was so nice for Gijs. You could see a happy little dog again, one I could pet again and who can/wants to go for nice long walks again. We are going back in about six months.
For whatever reason, he has a vulnerable little back, but if we can keep that under control with Jacha’s wonderful help, we will be super happy, and so will Gijs!

We stopped by with our French Bulldog because he had severe back pain. He could hardly walk, sit, pee, or relieve himself. After a session with Jacha, he was like a new dog and is going through life pain-free as a very cheerful little bulldog.
Super!!!!
Practically fine. Directions are useless! I don't follow any directions!
A very skilled doctor...beautiful practice

This orthomanual therapist is definitely worth treating your dog. We had our dachshund treated by her. After a warm welcome, she took our dachshund under her wing. Our dog remained very calm. It was wonderful to see. After this treatment, our dachshund feels completely at ease again. Excellent value for money.

We're so glad we met Jacha over two and a half years ago. My sweet French bulldog, Benji, had his first hernia three and a half years ago, leaving his back legs completely paralyzed. I'd heard a lot about Dr. Heukels back then, but we had an emergency, and unfortunately, her schedule was completely booked. We were put on the waiting list. Benji underwent surgery, after which he had to learn to walk again. He underwent 10 months of rehabilitation with hydrotherapy, and over a year after his first hernia, he had his second. He then needed another operation, but thankfully, he improved quickly, and we were able to see Dr. Heukels. Initially, he was in Bleiswijk, and since then, he's been in Amsterdam. We have him straightened at least once every six months, and thankfully, he's been doing very well ever since. We've also been able to visit him more often in between appointments when I was very worried because I saw that Benji was having difficulty walking or was experiencing discomfort. Jacha would immediately make room for us! And after that, he immediately started feeling better again! We're thrilled with her and grateful for what she does for us. Thanks to her, Benji is a happy dog ​​again and seems pain-free. We've decided together to visit him every three months from now on. I hope Benji (thanks in part to Dr. Heukels) has many more healthy years ahead! I recommend her to everyone!

In November 2022, our 11-year-old dog Ollie no longer enjoyed walking. After a fifteen-minute walk, she had to give up due to the pain. Panting heavily and visibly distressed, she slunk away because of the pain in her back and neck. It was so sad to see her suffer like that.
Our regular veterinarian couldn't find anything abnormal. The blood test was also fine, so she recommended painkillers.

I then went looking for an alternative treatment and actually found Dr. Jacha Heukels. It appeared that several vertebrae in the neck had become severely misaligned, as well as a number in the lower back. Jacha straightened these out and does so with great care for the animal. Two weeks later, we returned for the check-up treatment, and except for one small vertebra, everything was still neatly in place. "Super positive for a rescue dog of her age," Jacha confirmed. Since then, we go for a check-up appointment every 4 to 6 months, and Ollie is doing great. We even backpacked through England and Wales with Ollie in 2023 and 2024. Walking through the mountains like she was a young dog. Yesterday we went for another check-up. Ollie is almost 15 now and is still doing really well. Thank you Jacha! We are very grateful to you for the quality of life your treatments give Ollie 😍
Always helps our dachshund very well. Super!!
Helped our 5 Year old Corgi with misaligned neck vertbrae. In just about 3 weeks our dog was feeling much better after the treatment. Thank you so much for helping.

We visited last week with our French Bulldog, Elvis. It is fantastic what just one treatment has done for him! We had, of course, read the good reviews, but when you see that he remained so calm during the treatment—whereas normally he needs to be held firmly still on a treatment table—and was relieved of the pain afterwards and is running through the garden like a happy dog ​​again. We are very grateful for the good guidance, information, and especially the excellent help and care!
Very skilled. Dog cured of back pain in one go. Excellent.

My cat has received her 2nd orthomanual treatment and the result is fantastic!! We are so happy!!

The cat was adopted from the Amsterdam shelter a few months ago; she had been brought in after a car accident and appeared to have a spinal cord injury. X-rays showed no bone fractures. After 3 months of rest in a small space, the cat was able to manage a little and was allowed to be adopted.
At home, it was clear that the cat was collapsing on her hind leg, had a very strange gait, and sat completely crooked; she had sustained neurological damage from the accident.

I went to the passionate people at the pet shop "de Beestenboel" on Rijnstraat in Amsterdam for a consultation. They advised me to contact the Rivierenbuurt Veterinary Clinic on Rijnstraat in Amsterdam. They recommended Jacha Heukels, an orthomanual veterinarian. This veterinarian had previously worked at their practice, and they had seen very good results from her treatment. All X-rays and video of the cat were sent for an initial assessment; Jacha also believed that treatment might yield good results.

During the 1st consultation, Jacha noted that several thoracic and spinal vertebrae were misaligned and was already able to do a lot.
At home, it was evident that the cat was already making significant progress after a few days of recovering from the treatment and muscle pain. She was jumping, becoming increasingly active; her leg wasn't moving quite right yet, and her gait was still somewhat abnormal.
After the 2nd treatment, all vertebrae are aligned perfectly, and the cat is so happy! She walks much better, no longer drags her leg, and no longer collapses on it.

This cat is now (at 3 years old) looking forward to a pain-free, happy life!

Thank you, Jacha, for your expertise! and the kind way of treating and interacting with both animals and people!!
Cat Minoes
Update: now 2 years later, Minoes even climbs up to 2 meters high in the tree!!

Just perfect, just like every other time. Our assistance dog loves it, and her mood improves when she's helped. This is partly because she often catches her owner when she falls, so her owner's head doesn't hit the ground hard, but rather on her.
Our dachshund comes here once a year to have his vertebrae straightened, and he comes out feeling like a new person. This lady is a true professional.

So grateful for Jacha's help!

Our 1.5-year-old Jack Russell, Pip, displayed unwanted behavior that we couldn't explain. She was restless, constantly chewed on clothes, frequently chased her tail, and barked during meals and when visitors came—it was unbearable. We consulted a behavioral specialist, who suspected a medical cause. X-rays revealed misaligned vertebrae in Pip's spine. We were referred to Jacha, and after just the first treatment, we noticed a difference. After the second treatment, we saw even more improvement. Now, after three treatments, we have a dog who behaves appropriately for her age—happy, relaxed, and pain-free. What a difference! We won't be back for another six months.
We are incredibly grateful for Jacha's professional and loving help!

Raymond & Angela van Rooijen

Pleasant and honest consultation.

I came for an examination to rule out neurological complaints/problems, and left with the feeling that it had been thoroughly investigated. She did not try to push for extra treatments, but honestly let me know that she did not think the cause of our Labrador's problem was neurological (but rather osteoarthritis/injury).

About 3 weeks ago, we had a follow-up appointment with Jacha for our Woody (see the full story: https://orthomanueeldierenarts.nl/franse-bulldog-woody/).
Jacha was very enthusiastic (and so were we!) about the progress Woody has made from paralyzed to a happy French Bulldog again. In consultation with Jacha, we have undergone hydrotherapy and laser treatments with Marjolein Bil in Kwadendamme over the past few months, and the results can be described as very good! We took a break and resumed the hydrotherapy after the visit to Jacha. That is now about three more times, but spaced out a bit more (every 2 weeks). Of course, you can still see/notice the effects on Woody, and we don't know if it will improve much further, but the most important thing is that he can walk well again and is not in pain. In short, should you ever find yourself in this situation, do not hesitate and start immediately with an appointment with Jacha; there is a good chance your dog will be able to walk again without surgery! We have made another appointment for about six months from now. Once again, Jacha, thank you so much for your treatments! Mario & Marleen & Woody from Terneuzen

Our dachshund was in a lot of pain and needed a lot of medication to make it more bearable.
Since no one is normally allowed to touch him, we were worried he wouldn't tolerate the examination/treatment.
Surprisingly, he was very tolerant of everything and was easy to treat.

We were able to get an appointment very quickly, and after the examination, two vertebrae were immediately corrected.

Now, a month and a half later, our dachshund, Heinz, is back to his old self. He's playful, walking, running. He does everything again without medication and with great pleasure.

It's definitely worth a visit.

Highly recommended, a very positive experience!

Our 4-year-old dachshund had recently been experiencing some vague issues regarding movement and one moment of clear pain. She continued walking and running without restriction, but we still wanted to have it checked out because squatting, for example, didn't seem to go entirely smoothly. That was a good decision; it turned out the vertebrae were misaligned in three places.

Jacha Heukels is a wonderful vet, calm and clear in her approach and explanations. Our dog adored her too. We were able to ask many questions and received extensive advice on various aspects (which activities are most strenuous and why, which type of harness, etc.). We are now well-informed about how we can contribute to preventing further problems ourselves. After this single treatment, we plan to return every six months for a check-up.

I recommend anyone who is hesitant to go! Even if your dog's symptoms are not (yet) severe. We went home feeling very good and notice that our dog is moving very well again.
A quick appointment and well-considered treatment for our dachshund. It looks like everything will be fine.

I finally visited Heukels today with my nearly 6-year-old French Bulldog. He has been struggling with a herniated disc since last year, and now, a year later, the same symptoms have started again.

Pablo, my dog, was very relaxed at the practice, and after a treatment where she realigned all his vertebrae, he was still hopping around the treatment room in a relaxed manner. 5 stars!
We received good help. Dog happy, owner happy😉 …

5 stars are not enough; Dr. Heukels is a top veterinarian with great skill and knowledge, and a heart for animals. Our German Shorthaired Pointer, Olaf, was in a lot of pain; he could barely do anything anymore despite all kinds of medication, physiotherapy, and laser therapy. Almost immediately after the first visit to Dr. Heukels, Olaf started running and playing again as if he felt like a puppy. He also suddenly lashed out at other dogs much less, which led us to realize that this had also been due to pain. We are incredibly grateful to Dr. Heukels that, thanks to her, we have our happy dog ​​back.

When regular veterinarians were getting nowhere and my dog's gait became increasingly difficult, I started looking for an alternative treatment that might help. After extensive online research, I ended up with chiropractic care. Because I wanted a practitioner with a broad perspective, I chose an orthomanual veterinarian. Someone who also had to have a veterinary degree. Because the Heukels orthomanual veterinary medicine website looked very professional, I decided to go there.
There was a very long waiting list, and I live over 150 kilometers away, but I was happy to pay that price for my dog's care, even the rather expensive price of 105 euros. Unfortunately, the treatment was very disappointing and felt unprofessional. I didn't feel like anyone was truly listening. At one point, my dog ​​became restless when I touched her just past her groin, so I told her that was where she was complaining about pain. This was dismissed rather dismissively, as if my dog ​​was being dramatic. The dog was felt around and forced into certain positions, and then she said she had straightened some vertebrae and that we should come back in six weeks.
Immediately after the treatment, our dog's condition deteriorated significantly and she could barely walk. We went to another chiropractor a few weeks later, where it turned out that one side of her pelvis was severely prolapsed and misaligned. This was completely overlooked by Mrs. Heukels.

I wouldn't advise anyone to go after this, as the image painted on the website is completely different from reality. Based on the website, I expected a professional veterinarian. Furthermore, your dog might end up worse off than when he went.
Very skilled doctor

Our 12-year-old dachshund was successfully treated (again) by Dr. Heukels last week. Thank you for allowing us to come so quickly and for the loving and expert care our dog received from Dr. Heukels. A fantastic orthomanual veterinarian, and we're happy to make a detour for him! Kind regards,
Mirjam Engels

Thank you for all the good care you provided for Clio and Soof. Clio has had two hernia operations and is now 15 years old. Thanks to all your wonderful and trusted treatments, she is still living comfortably. The same goes for 12-year-old Soof 🥰👍 …
Nice, professional doctor, and it's very nice that there is always a parking spot.

We came here with our French Bulldog when she was suffering terribly from back pain. After a correction of her vertebrae, she was practically as good as new the same day; we were able to wean off the painkillers very quickly, and it hasn't returned to this day. Highly recommended!
Professional therapist

Jacha Heukels is a fantastic orthomanual veterinarian. I have a 6-year-old dachshund with all sorts of vague complaints, without a herniated disc. After the first treatment, I quickly noticed a clear difference. Now we drop by once every 6 months to loosen up a few vertebrae again and to check if “everything is still in place”. I trust Jacha 100% with my dog! She is very gentle and calm, which I personally find very important when working with animals.
I think this vet is incredibly good. She quickly relieved my cat of her pain.
